strings.name: Darren Woods
strings.role: Energy executive · ExxonMobil chairman and CEO
strings.summary: Woods joined Exxon in 1992 and rose through refining, supply and corporate leadership before becoming chairman and CEO in 2017. Under him the company expanded upstream oil and gas and invested in carbon capture through acquisitions and low-carbon businesses. Its strategy faces competing energy, shareholder and climate pressures; investments and targets are not completed climate benefits.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a real-time news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Led ExxonMobil, participating in global oil-and-gas development, refining and chemical investment, and low-carbon technology strategies.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birth
strings.facts.f1.value: Born in Wichita, Kansas; public age information places his birth in 1964 or 1965, without a confirmed exact birthday.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Electrical-engineering bachelor’s, Texas A&M; MBA, Northwestern’s Kellogg School.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Global energy operations
strings.highlights.h1.text: Led oil and gas, refining and supply activities and capital allocation in a major energy business.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Carbon-capture investment
strings.highlights.h2.text: Developed low-carbon operations and acquired Denbury; investment and realized emissions reductions require separate assessment.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Pioneer acquisition
strings.timeline.t1.text: ExxonMobil completed its Pioneer acquisition, expanding Permian Basin operations.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Denbury acquisition
strings.timeline.t2.text: Completed the acquisition, expanding carbon-dioxide pipelines and carbon-capture-and-storage assets.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Low-carbon business
strings.timeline.t3.text: Established Low Carbon Solutions to develop carbon capture and related projects.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Chairman and CEO
strings.timeline.t4.text: Succeeded Tillerson as ExxonMobil chairman and chief executive.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Group president
strings.timeline.t5.text: Became president and joined the board.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Senior leadership
strings.timeline.t6.text: Advanced from refining to senior vice president.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Refining and supply
strings.timeline.t8.title: Joined Exxon
strings.timeline.t8.text: Entered Exxon and developed international operating experience in refining.
